description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a medical exam preparation chatbot that uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approach. It handles UI setup, session state management, integration with vector store and OpenAI API, and orchestrates the question-answering process based on textbook chapters and embedded content.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class managing vector storage and search functionalities for textbook content.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embeddings for text queries.

classes.name: AsyncOpenAI
classes.description: A class providing asynchronous methods to interact with OpenAI's API.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs embedding, search, and generates a comprehensive answer based on textbook content and user question.
